checks.name: Recenter, pause and exit
checks.summary: recenter: pressed True, event True, yaw -32.8 -> 0 deg; pause and resume True; exit: event True, app ended True

evidence.label: the app ended (its probe stopped updating)

manual.how: Headset removed or the Meta button: the probe should log 'pause system' or 'pause focus' and sound should stop. Needs a headset, or the simulator's own control for it.

checks.name: Hand tracking lost mid-press and found again: no ghost press
checks.summary: right hand lost True and back True; presses during and after: 0 (count 0 -> 0); cancels: 1

evidence.label: was the button held down when tracking was dropped

data.command: metavr.cmd xrsim input source --hand right --source none

evidence.label: press cancelled by the tracking loss

checks.name: MP4 of the simulator for every app session

startCommand.command: ffmpeg -f gdigrab (simulator window, 1582x1190 at 15 fps) -c:v libx264 session2-sample.mp4

stopCommand.command: ffmpeg -f gdigrab (simulator window, 1582x1190 at 15 fps) -c:v libx264 session2-sample.mp4

startCommand.command: ffmpeg -f gdigrab (simulator window, 1582x1190 at 15 fps) -c:v libx264 session3-tracking.mp4

stopCommand.command: ffmpeg -f gdigrab (simulator window, 1582x1190 at 15 fps) -c:v libx264 session3-tracking.mp4

notes: The simulator runtime has no MP4 recorder (metavr xrsim record says its build doesn't include the recording service), so FFmpeg recorded the simulator window: the 3D view as the simulator showed it, plus its side panel.

manual.how: Check each MP4 shows the steps above (the script only checks the files exist and have a length).
